    won_deals,
    dead_deals,
    win_rate_percentage
FROM (
    WITH sector_stats AS (
        SELECT

            SUM(CASE WHEN is_won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_deals,
            SUM(CASE WHEN is_dead THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_deals,
            CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_won OR is_dead THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS win_rate
        FROM
            deals
        WHERE
            is_won OR is_dead
        GROUP BY
            COALESCE(sector, 'Unassigned')
    ),
    overall_stats AS (
        SELECT
            SUM(CASE WHEN is_won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_deals,
            SUM(CASE WHEN is_dead THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dead_deals,
            CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN is_won THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN is_won OR is_dead THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS win_rate
        FROM
            deals
        WHERE

    SELECT
        sector,
        won_deals,

    SELECT

) AS combined_results

turn.intent: Summarize key performance metrics for the energy segment (Powerline and Renewables).
turn.sql:
WITH EnergyDeals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN deal_status = 'Open' THEN deal_value ELSE 0 END) AS pipeline_value,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN deal_status = 'Open' AND deal_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS pipeline_valued_deals,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN deal_status = 'Open' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS pipeline_total_deals,

        SUM(CASE WHEN deal_status = 'Won' THEN deal_value ELSE 0 END) AS won_deals_value,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN deal_status = 'Won' AND deal_value IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS won_deals_valued_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN deal_status = 'Won' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS won_deals_total_count,

        CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_won = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) AS won_count_for_win_rate,
        CAST(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_won = TRUE OR is_dead = TRUE) AS DOUBLE) AS closed_count_for_win_rate
    FROM deals
    WHERE sector ILIKE '%Powerline%' OR sector ILIKE '%Renewables%'
),
EnergyWorkOrders AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(amount_incl_gst) AS total_wo_value,
        SUM(outstanding_incl_gst) AS outstanding_receivables
    FROM work_orders
    WHERE sector ILIKE '%Powerline%' OR sector ILIKE '%Renewables%'
)
SELECT
    'Energy Segment' AS segment_name,
    ed.pipeline_value,
    ed.pipeline_valued_deals,
    ed.pipeline_total_deals,
    ed.won_deals_value,
    ed.won_deals_valued_count,
    ed.won_deals_total_count,
    ROUND(ed.won_count_for_win_rate * 100.0 / NULLIF(ed.closed_count_for_win_rate, 0), 2) AS win_rate_percent,
    ewo.total_wo_value,
    ewo.outstanding_receivables
FROM EnergyDeals AS ed, EnergyWorkOrders AS ewo;
assumptions: The 'energy segment' is defined by deals and work orders in the 'Powerline' or 'Renewables' sectors.
Pipeline value is the sum of deal_value for open deals.
Win rate is calculated as (won deals / (won deals + dead deals)) * 100, rounded to two decimal places.
